# Synthetic POP3 retrieve. Wire is CRLF; password is a dummy.
S: +OK fake.kiwi-test.invalid POP3 FakeKIWI
C: USER test-user@kiwi-test.invalid
S: +OK send PASS
C: PASS REDACTED-DUMMY
S: +OK logged in, 1 message
C: LIST
S: +OK 1 message (320 octets)
S: 1 320
S: .
C: UIDL
S: +OK
S: 1 FAKEUID0001
S: .
C: RETR 1
S: +OK 320 octets
S: From: alice@kiwi-test.invalid
S: To: bob@kiwi-test.invalid
S: Subject: synthetic hello
S:
S: Hello from the fixture.
S: .
C: QUIT
S: +OK FakeKIWI signing off
